Score the picks

score_picks.Rd

Each player's points for each team they picked, every day: the wage when the pick matches the team's status, minus the wage when it does not, 0 for a push, and missing before the team's first game.

Usage

score_picks(standings_grid, picks)

add_changes(player_projections_by_team)

rows_for_day(changes, day)

projected_score_by_player(player_projections_by_team)

rank_players(projected_score, today)

Arguments

standings_grid

The result of build_standings_grid().

picks

One row per pick: team, player, wage, and choice ("OVER" or "UNDER").

player_projections_by_team

The result of score_picks().

changes

The result of add_changes().

day

A Date.

projected_score

The result of projected_score_by_player().

today

The day the page is built (a Date).

Value

score_picks() returns one row per player, team, and day. add_changes() returns the rows where a pick's points moved from the day before. A team's points are missing until its first game, so a missing value counts as 0: otherwise every team's first game would drop out of the changes. rows_for_day() keeps one day of those. projected_score_by_player() returns each player's total points and counts of correct picks by day (missing points count as 0 and as not correct). rank_players() returns the players, best first, by points, then correct picks, then correct 15-point picks, on the date closest to today.

Examples

pool <- with(pool_example, compute_pool(game_results_raw, scores, projections,
  picks, standings, params$yesterday, params$today, params$season_start,
  params$num_games))
scored <- pool$scored_picks
ch <- add_changes(scored)
rows_for_day(ch, as.Date("2026-10-21"))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 7
#>   Date       Player Team                 `Current Record` `Current Win %`
#>   <date>     <chr>  <chr>                <chr>                      <dbl>
#> 1 2026-10-21 P1     Alpha                1-1                           50
#> 2 2026-10-21 P2     Alpha                1-1                           50
#> 3 2026-10-21 P2     Los Angeles Clippers 1-0                          100
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: `Vegas Win Projection %` <dbl>,
#> #   `Change in Points Since Yesterday` <dbl>
ps <- projected_score_by_player(scored)
rank_players(ps, today = as.Date("2026-10-22"))
#> [1] "P1" "P2"
